name: @jsprismarine/docs
description: Builds the documentation site with VitePress; the API reference comes from TypeDoc, which still needs TypeScript 6

scripts.docs:sources: pnpm --filter @jsprismarine/bedrock-data run fetch:sources && pnpm --filter @jsprismarine/bedrock-data run datagen:java
scripts.docs: pnpm run docs:sources && pnpm run docs:generate && pnpm run docs:content && vitepress build site
scripts.docs:check: pnpm run docs:generate && concurrently --prefix '{name}' --kill-others-on-fail pnpm:docs:stage "typedoc --emit none"
scripts.docs:dev: pnpm run docs:sources && pnpm run docs:generate && pnpm run docs:content && vitepress dev site
